Get out of the channelled Torch Flame; Lava Plume hits hardest far out, so stay close

general: [1.4, F14] All seven pre-level-90 timelines are open from first entering the Monolith; there is no complete-X-to-unlock-Y tree any more.

[1.4, F14; still present in 1.5 per MX15 and the 1.5-preview1 quest datamine] The three level 90 timelines are behind the quest 'Knowledge of Orobyss' (5 Knowledge). Sources of Knowledge: Campaign Chapter IX 1, Chapter X 1, Fall of the Outcasts 1, The Stolen Lance 1, The Black Sun 1, Blood Frost and Death 1, Ending the Storm 1, Fall of the Empire 2, Reign of Dragons 2. Knowledge is shared by all characters on the same stash.
[1.5, MX15] Completing the Knowledge of Orobyss quest gives +2 to all attributes.

[MXL, 2026-09-29] Recommended order for a new character: Fall of the Outcasts, The Stolen Lance, The Black Sun, Reign of Dragons (1+1+1+2 = 5 Knowledge), then one level 90 timeline to unlock Empowered.

[TUNK] Each normal timeline has 3 quest echoes gated by stability; the third is the boss. [MXB] They must be done in order. [1.4, F14] 'Echo quests are now only present in normal difficulty timelines.'
[MXB] Stability comes from completing echoes; echoes further from the web centre give more, plus bonus stability from kills in the echo. [MXT] Killing the timeline boss resets stability.

[MXB/MXG] Killing a timeline boss offers a choice of blessings; a character has one blessing slot per timeline boss. Re-kill the boss for a new offer. A blessing only has to be offered once to be discovered; discovered blessings can be re-selected at Chronomancer Nyx in the End of Time at your best roll.
[TUNK/MXE] Empowered timelines offer the Grand versions (same stat, higher range). [MXE] At 200+ corruption the boss offers one more blessing option.
[TUNK/MXB] Corruption: normal timelines run 0 to 50, empowered start at 100 with no cap. It raises enemy health and damage and increases item rarity and experience.

[MXB/MXS] Corruption is raised by killing the Shade of Orobyss echo; Shades further from the web centre give more, and the kill resets the echo web. Each timeline boss kill adds Gaze of Orobyss, which increases corruption from the next Shade; Gaze is lost if you die to the Shade. The Sanctuary of Eterra echo next to the web start lowers corruption (3 options).

[1.4, F14 + MXB/MXE] Empowered unlock: complete one level 90 timeline on normal; the first Harbinger appears in that boss echo; defeat it, then open the chest on the centre island between the three level 90 timelines. This unlocks empowered (area level 100) for all 10 timelines and the Forgotten Knights faction (Shattered Road).
[1.2, F12] Normal timeline unlocks are shared between characters on the same stash; an alt still has to complete one level 90 timeline itself to get Empowered.
[MXK, 1.3-dated] Aberroth requires killing all 10 Harbingers (in empowered timelines at the corruption shown in the Forgotten Knights panel) and spending 1 Harbinger Eye at the Shattered Road.
[MXW] The Woven faction and Weaver Tree unlock by completing a Cemetery echo in any timeline web; the exit portal leads to the Haven of Silk, talk to Masque.

[MXF, 1.5] Item factions (Merchant's Guild / Circle of Fortune) are joined in Maj'elka Upper District in Chapter 9 via Zerrick, then Nama at the Bazaar or Galila at the Observatory; a Temporal Sanctum key plus a Chronomancer Julra kill is a shortcut to Chapter 9.

[MXL, 2026-09-29] Leveling guides leave the campaign after Chapter 7 with the quest-reward caps reached (15 passive points, 8 idol slots) and go straight to the Monolith. See campaign-research.md for the quest list and the open question about the cap in 1.5.
[MXDG] Dungeon keys: timeline bosses are the recommended key source (drop chance scales with item rarity). [TUNK] The Abomination loot table has two key rolls of 18%-70% each.

[MXD] Resistances cap at 75%. Grand Survival of Might (Reign of Dragons) is named as one of the best sources of critical strike avoidance. [MXT] Per-timeline advice is to cap the resistances matching the boss damage types.
[1.5, MX15] 'Entering an echo that has previously been attempted now provides significantly less XP and favor, in addition to the existing reductions to random encounters and loot.'

[1.5, MX15] 'Echo of the World has been renamed to Traveler's Rest.' 'Traveler's Rest now has a waypoint, which can be accessed from the End of Time Era.' 'You can now change timelines directly from the Monolith of Fate through the new Nexus UI.'

[1.5, MX15/MXM] Rage of Morditas: Blood Crystal encounters in echoes feed a kill counter (campaign encounters do not count). Woven echoes unlock at 750 kills (Site of Carnage), 2,000 (Blood of Farwood) and 4,000 (Circle of Frozen Blood = Morditas). Beating Morditas gives the Demigod's Ascendance woven echo (Pinnacle Morditas), which requires 400 corruption. Anger raises difficulty and rewards of the three echoes and can be reduced freely in the Nexus.

[TUNKJS, 1.5-preview1 scenes; not checked against a live log] Scene ids: MonolithHub = Monolith of Fate (timeline map), M_Rest = Traveler's Rest (in-timeline hub), EoT = The End of Time, M_Shade = Echo of a World (Shade of Orobyss), M_Sanctuary = Sanctuary of Eterra, M_Harbinger = Altar of Orobyss, M_Knight = Shattered Road, WeaversHub = Haven of Silk, PCG_Cemetery / PCG_Tomb, R<n>Q10/20/30 = quest echoes, M_<zone> = normal echoes, M_Arena_* = arena echoes, WE<n> = woven echoes (WE539 Site of Carnage, WE538 Blood of Farwood, WE536 Circle of Frozen Blood, WE537 Demigod's Ascendance).
